# HARICA

> HARICA (Hellenic Academic & Research Institutions Certification Authority) issues trusted digital certificates and qualified eIDAS electronic signatures, seals, server (TLS) and code signing certificates for individuals, businesses and enterprises.

HARICA operates CertManager for certificate issuance and management, participates in major root‑CA trust programs (Mozilla, Microsoft, Apple, Oracle) and provides qualified PSD2/QWAC services and partner/reseller programs.

## Products

- [eSignatures](https://www.harica.gr/en/esignatures.index.md): Describes HARICA’s electronic signature products (advanced and qualified), remote qualified signatures, and pricing/options for individuals and organizations.  
- [eSeal – HARICA](https://www.harica.gr/en/eseal/): Explains electronic seals for legal entities, advanced vs qualified seals, PSD2 options and remote qualified eSeal service.  
- [Server Certificates – HARICA](https://www.harica.gr/en/server-certificates): Describes SSL/TLS server certificate types (DV, IV, OV, EV, QWAC, PSD2) and uses for website security.  
- [Email Certificate – HARICA](https://www.harica.gr/en/email-certificate): Describes S/MIME email signing/encryption certificates, options for individuals and organizations.  
- [Code Signing – HARICA](https://www.harica.gr/en/code-signing): Explains code signing certificates (IV, OV, EV), what they sign, and use cases to increase software trust.

## Guides

- [Domain Validated (DV) SSL/TLS Certificate request](https://www.harica.gr/en/guides/domain-validated-dv-ssl-tls-certificate-request/): Step‑by‑step guide to request, validate and obtain a DV SSL/TLS certificate via HARICA CertManager.  
- [Code signing certificate request for individuals or sole proprietorships (IV)](https://www.harica.gr/en/guides/code-signing-certificate-request-for-individuals-or-sole-proprietorships-iv/): Stepwise instructions to request, validate, pay for, retrieve and import an individual (IV) code signing certificate and token handling.  
- [Best Practices for Code Signing Certificates – HARICA](https://www.harica.gr/en/BestPractices/CodeSigning): Guidance on protecting code‑signing private keys, time‑stamping, test vs release signing, virus scanning and key management.

## Solutions & Services

- [Solutions for Individuals](https://www.harica.gr/en/individuals-services): Outlines certificate choices and use cases for personal users and sole proprietors (eSignature, email, server certificates).  
- [Solutions for Small Businesses](https://www.harica.gr/en/small-businesses-services): Describes recommended products and services for small organizations (server certs, eSignatures, eSeals) and contact options.  
- [Solutions for Enterprises](https://www.harica.gr/en/enterprise-services): Describes enterprise offerings including large‑scale server certificates, eSignatures/eSeals, code signing and options to host a CA with HARICA support.  
- [PSD2 Certificates for the FinTech industry – HARICA](https://www.harica.gr/en/posts/post-3211/): Describes HARICA’s QWAC and QSealC PSD2 qualified certificates and pricing for financial services.

## Support & Partnerships

- [Customer Support](https://www.harica.gr/en/customer-support/index.md): Contact channels, support hours, sales contact and procedures for certificate problem and high‑priority reporting.  
- [Resellers and Partners](https://www.harica.gr/en/resellers-partners/): Reseller and partner program options (Reseller, Partner with remote QSCD, Partner with RA), requirements and benefits.  
- [Repository](https://repo.harica.gr/): HARICA’s document/repository host for policies and procedural documents (linked from site).  
- [CERT Manager API Documentation](https://developer.harica.gr/): API documentation for HARICA’s CertManager certificate management platform.  
- [Login to CertManager](https://cm.harica.gr/): HARICA’s CertManager portal for ordering, managing and retrieving certificates (including Problem Reporting links used in support pages).

## Blog & Technical Posts

- [Best Practices for Code Signing Certificates – HARICA](https://www.harica.gr/en/posts/post-5682/): Blog post detailing code signing best practices, key protection, time‑stamping and virus scanning.  
- [Code Signing – HARICA](https://www.harica.gr/en/posts/post-category/code-signing): Category page listing code signing related posts and the linked best practices article.  
- [Virus Scanning – HARICA](https://www.harica.gr/en/posts/post-tag/virus-scanning): Tag page aggregating posts related to virus scanning and secure code release practices.

## Optional

- [Trust & Compliance](https://www.harica.gr/en/trust.index.md): Overview of HARICA’s participation in global trust programs, eIDAS conformance and compliance facts.  
- [Policy](https://www.harica.gr/en/policy.index.md): Link text indicates HARICA’s policy and procedures repository (site links to detailed policy documents).  
- [Data Privacy Statement (PDF)](https://www.harica.gr/wp-content/uploads/2025/03/Data-Privacy-Statement-EN.pdf): HARICA’s data privacy statement in PDF form.
